page.overview:
Who is Ceratosuchops?

is a genus spinosaurid theropod dinosaur from the Early Cretaceous (Barremian) of Britain.

The animal was named in 2021 alongside another spinosaurid called and its name means "horned crocodile face", with the species name inferodios meaning "hell heron".

Ceratosuchops was among the animals in the Jurassic World: Chaos Theory toyline that were added to the app on October 31, 2024.

Ceratosuchops featured in the Epic Evolution toy line. This is not only its first appearance in Jurassic Park franchise as a toy or as a whole, but also its first ever appearance in the media.
